articles.headline: Pistons roll past Heat 128-111, adding to Miami's season-opening woes on defensive end
articles.description: — John Collins scored 23 points, Paul Reed added 19 off the bench and the Detroit Pistons added to Miami's season-opening defensive misery by beating the Heat 128-111 on Friday night.
